calibration.objective: sqrt(sum squared output errors / sum squared FP32 reference outputs), pooled over the fixed development subset
calibration.ties: First minimum in ascending listed tau then h order; no refinement.

scale.layout: Consecutive key elements within one head/query row, reset at each attention tile.
scale.out_of_range: Clamp exponent, recompute code with that scale; count below-range blocks and represented zero scales.
scale.nearest_ceil: ceil((local shifted maximum - ln(6))/ln(2)); headroom scale. Independent MXFP4 numerical reference, not verified paper baseline.
scale.nearest_efq_scale: Nearest E2M1 under exactly paper Eq. 8; midpoint ties to even code index.
scale.masked_or_padding: Masked entries get zero codes; all-masked blocks do not contribute; partial blocks padded with masked entries.

metrics.unit: document x length x layer x query head; Frobenius norm across 16 sampled query outputs, all valid keys per query
metrics.near_zero: Relative error null when reference RMS <= 1e-6; retain absolute Frobenius and count.
metrics.js: Natural logs, FP64-renormalized historical-rescaled effective probabilities; stable log1p/even-series calculation. Attention arithmetic stays FP32.
metrics.top_k_ties: Stable descending probability sort, ascending key index; k=min(8, number of valid keys).
metrics.tie_fraction: Adjacent equal effective probabilities after sorting / (valid keys - 1), includes zero ties; 0 for one valid key.
metrics.zero_fraction: Generated E2M1 zero codes among valid keys, before historical rescaling.
metrics.removed_mass: Dense reference probability mass at generated zero-code keys.
metrics.max_jump: Largest finite increase after a previous finite online row maximum; excludes initialization.
metrics.aggregation: Median/p95/max over head units, also per length/layer/head. Repeated prefixes/rows are not independent documents.

bootstrap.statistic: Mean per-document unit error difference calibrated minus nearest_same_scale, separately per length.

screen.near_zero_or_missing_policy: Count/report; cannot silently pass. Hold ratio when baseline is at floor.
screen.meaning: Project engineering screen only; no quality preservation or acceleration claim.

errors.fully_masked_row: Return zero output and valid=false; count separately.
errors.valid_zero_denominator: Preserve failure/NaN, do not repair; screen fails.
errors.execution_error: Save stage and traceback; no silent retries.

split_policy: Extract only development until numerical tests, small native trace check and calibration pass; freeze spec before first evaluation extraction.
